integrity: The known mean-optimal profile is explicitly credited to its source, and the distributional results have independent analytic derivations with a reproducible standard-library checker. Numerical checks do not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact mean-optimizing coefficient vanishes at the absorbing endpoint, while its strictly positive regularizations are not asserted to optimize the mean. Only existence, not uniqueness, of a CDF crossing is proved. Classical spectral and Bessel results underpin the calculations; full historical priority cannot be certified.
scope: Drift-free one-dimensional Ito diffusion with reflection at the launch endpoint, absorption at the opposite endpoint, and a fixed spatial-average diffusivity budget.
title: Mean-optimal diffusivity delays the earliest escapes while accelerating the late tail
